working_definition: Cells of the adult maxillary palp (FCA proboscis and maxillary palps), mostly sensory neurons; authors' FBbt term is the appendage maxillary palp.
justification: Authors' term FBbt:00004546 (maxillary palp) is an appendage, not a cell term. FBbt has no general cell term for maxillary palp cells or sensory neurons; maxillary palp olfactory receptor neuron covers only the olfactory subset and would narrow the authors' call. Held per curation rule B.
